activities.name: Festa do Avante! (September 4-6, 2026)
activities.description: A major political-cultural festival organized by the Portuguese Communist Party featuring music, theatre, and cinema at Quinta da Atalaia in Amora, Seixal, across the Tagus from Lisbon.

activities.name: MOTELx Horror Film Festival (Mid-September 2026)
activities.description: Portugal's most important horror film festival featuring premieres, retrospectives, and guest talks at Cinema São Jorge in central Lisbon.

activities.name: Santa Casa Alfama Music Festival (Mid-Late September 2026)
activities.description: An annual fado music festival featuring concerts in historic chapels, palaces, and outdoor squares in the Alfama district.

activities.description: A legendary Portuguese music festival featuring major standalone concerts, kicking off with The Weeknd at Estádio do Restelo in Lisbon.

activities.name: Kizomba Festival Lisboa (September 2026)
activities.description: An Afro-Lusophone kizomba dance festival with workshops, socials, and performances across various venues in Lisbon.

activities.name: Misty Fest (September 2026)
activities.description: An autumn concert festival featuring intimate shows in venues across Lisbon and Sintra, often in palaces and theatres.

activities.name: Lisbon Architecture Triennale (September 2026)
activities.description: A major exhibition of architecture and urban design featuring installations and talks across various venues in Lisbon.
activities.address: Office:, Campo de Santa Clara 142, 1100-474 Lisboa, Portugal

activities.name: Chronosphere Festival (September 18-20, 2026)
activities.description: A music and arts gathering in Góis, featuring electronic, ambient, and experimental music, with workshops exploring neurodiverse perspectives.

activities.name: Rota das Tapas Lisboa (September 2026)
activities.description: A citywide tapas route offering promotional small plates in over 100 restaurants across Lisbon.

activities.name: Lisbon & Sintra Film Festival (September 2026)
